body: commit 07263c4 -- every allied hero within the new ARENA_LANE_CREEP_XP_SHARE_RADIUS (8.0) now shares XP on a lane creep kill, not just the killer. Flow/gold stays individual/precise, unchanged. New test confirms nearby-ally-shares vs far-ally-nothing. Full suite + test_10_bots.sh green.
title: S170-216: XP-share radius on lane creep kills
